build_pop2piano_processor: build a Pop2PianoProcessor instance from pretrained model weights using from_pretrained
call_processor_audio_notes: call the Pop2PianoProcessor with audio input and sampling rate to extract musical features
call_processor_with_notes: call the Pop2PianoProcessor with pre-extracted MIDI notes to encode them via the tokenizer
batch_decode_midi_notes: batch decode model-generated token_ids back to MIDI note sequences using the processor
save_processor_to_disk: save a Pop2PianoProcessor instance to a local directory with save_pretrained
